$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/) for a CSV imported with r/import.R. The names here are tags: import.R gives each field the name of the CSV column tagged with it, adds the other CSV columns as strings, and checks the file. A line list (no cases column, one row per case) drops cases and the unique constraint on date.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: The day (or the last day of the week, or the year) the counts are for. ISO dates (2020-03-01) unless the import gives another format.

fields.name: cases
fields.title: New cases
fields.description: New cases on that date, not a running total.

fields.name: deaths
fields.title: New deaths
fields.description: New deaths on that date, not a running total. Optional.
